text:
Maya: Hey team — planning to cut over the slicer pool swap tonight 19:00 PT. Goal: swap low-latency slices into reserved pool, bump minscale from 2->4, and activate new autoscale smoothing (alpha=0.6). Who's on deploy and who will run smoke? Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/slicer-swap

Tomas: I can own the deploy. Will be online 18:45 PT. I'll do the `kubectl rollout status` and the pool toggles.

Samira: I'll run smoke tests and perf checks. Smoke checklist: quick synth traffic, check p99, tail logs for OOMs. I'll post results.

Arjun: FYI the PR with the autoscale change is merged: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/4821 — we've added `min_replica: 4` and smoothing param. Also updated metric filter to exclude warmup spikes.

Maya: Thx. Quick ask — if smoke p99 > 250ms, rollback immediately? what's our cutoff?

Tomas: Yes — if p99 increases > 25% over baseline or errors > 0.5%, rollback. Rollback command: `helm rollback slicer-pool 2` (we'll tag the release as v2). I'll annotate in deploy notes.

Samira: I'll run these scripts: `./scripts/synth_traffic.sh --qps 40 --duration 3m` and `./scripts/check_p99.sh`. Posting baseline numbers now: baseline p99=180ms, error rate=0.02%.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: slicer-swap at 2025-09-12T02:00:00Z (internal ID job-8843) :white_check_mark:

Maya: Canary window: enable canary for 20% of traffic for 10 minutes then promote if no regressions. Also keep KV cache warmers running.

Arjun: Note — there's a small TTL change in the config; it may increase cold-start tokens for 1-2 minutes. It's expected.

Samira: Smoke started 19:10 PT — quick summary: p99=190ms, errors 0.01%, no OOMs. Logs look clean. :thumbsup: 

Tomas: Cutover started 19:20 PT. Performing pool swap: `curl -X POST https://api.internal/v1/pools/swap -d '{"from":"staging","to":"reserved","slices":["slicer-A","slicer-B"]}'` — changes pushed.

Maya: Monitoring: Grafana link https://grafana.redwood/d/slicer -> watching p95/p99, error inbox, and queue depth.

Samira: Canary passed 19:34 PT. p99 peaked 210ms then normalized. Promoting.

Arjun: After promote, verify autoscaler metrics for 30m. I will watch.

Tomas: Post-deploy sanity: `kubectl get pods -l app=slicer -o wide` shows expected replicas 4 in reserved pool.

Maya: Great — closing. If anyone sees >25% p99 spike or errors >0.5% we roll back. Otherwise we'll mark as done in the runbook.

Samira: Marking smoke PASS and closing my checklist. :white_check_mark: 

Tomas: Done. Updated deployment notes with rollout ID job-8843.

Maya: Thanks all. I'll follow up with capacity billing estimates tomorrow.
